scoring_model.description: Each detected indicator contributes an explicit weighted integer score. The aggregate is normalized to 0-100 without black-box ML or opaque embeddings.

signals.name: Credential & Auth Secret Harvesting
signals.reason: Legitimate institutions, banks, and customer care executives never request OTPs, PINs, or passwords.
signals.recommendation: Never disclose OTP, PIN, or CVV. Terminate contact immediately.

signals.name: Account Blocking & Panicking Threat
signals.reason: Scammers fabricate imminent penalties to provoke emotional panic and prevent rational verification.
signals.recommendation: Do not panic. Formal bank notices are served via written communications, not urgent chat/SMS.

signals.name: Manufactured Time-Pressure Deadline
signals.pattern: \b(immediate|immediately|urgent|urgently|within \d+ hours?|within 24 hours?|within 10 minutes?|today only|last chance|action required)\b
signals.reason: Artificial urgency short-circuits critical thinking and forces victims into impulsive decisions.
signals.recommendation: Pause and verify independently. Genuine administrative matters allow ample response time.

signals.name: Customer Care & Service Authority Pretext
signals.pattern: \b(customer care|support desk|helpdesk|service executive|officer|sbi support|hdfc care|airtel kyc|jio 5g|electricity board|customs officer|courier officer)\b
signals.reason: Impersonating recognizable utility or telecom brands builds deceptive credibility.
signals.recommendation: Contact the service provider through official directory helplines only.

signals.name: Unverified URLs & Screen-Sharing Tools
signals.reason: Shortened links or remote desktop software allow fraudsters to siphon OTPs or control the device.
signals.recommendation: Never install remote desktop software or APKs at the request of an unsolicited contact.

signals.name: Routine Task / Lottery / KYC Baits
signals.pattern: \b(kyc update|kyc pending|pan card update|electricity bill update|lottery winner|lucky draw|cash prize|won \d+|reward points?)\b
signals.reason: Exploits routine obligations (KYC, electricity) or financial greed (lottery) as lure.
signals.recommendation: Check KYC or billing status directly on the official banking or utility web portal.

signals.name: Reverse UPI PIN Entry Request
signals.reason: Fundamental UPI Rule: Entering your UPI PIN always DEBITS funds from your account, never credits it.
signals.recommendation: Do not enter your UPI PIN. Receiving money on UPI requires zero authorization or PIN entry.

signals.name: QR Code Scanning to Receive Money Claim
signals.reason: Scanning a QR code in a payment app initiates a payment transfer OUT of your bank account.
signals.recommendation: Never scan a QR code provided by a buyer or caller claiming to send you money or refunds.

signals.name: UPI Collect Request Approval Trap
signals.reason: Scammers send UPI Collect Requests for arbitrary amounts instructing victims to approve them to receive funds.
signals.recommendation: Decline unexpected Collect Requests and verify sender VPA.

signals.name: Accidental Transfer & Fake Refund Pretext
signals.pattern: \b(refund|transferred by mistake|sent money by mistake|return excess|overpaid|cashback reward|claim reward)\b
signals.reason: Claims of accidental money transfers push victims to return funds before checking bank balance.
signals.recommendation: Log into your official banking app and verify your actual ledger statement before responding.

signals.name: Payment Window Countdown Pressure
signals.reason: Artificial deadlines impede independent consultation with banks or family.
signals.recommendation: Take time to verify recipient credentials through authentic banking records.

signals.name: Law Enforcement / Digital Arrest Coercion
signals.pattern: \b(cbi|police|cyber cell|enforcement directorate|ed|customs|narcotics control bureau|ncb|court order|arrest warrant|supreme court|digital arrest|inspector|sub-inspector)\b
signals.reason: No Indian judicial or police agency conducts arrests or trials over Skype/WhatsApp or demands online bail deposits.
signals.recommendation: Disconnect immediately and report to the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930.

signals.name: Central Bank / Bank Official Impersonation
signals.pattern: \b(rbi|reserve bank|sbi|state bank|hdfc|icici|axis bank|punjab national bank|pnb|bank manager|kyc officer|compliance department)\b
signals.reason: Banks never reach out via personal messaging to demand credential or account verification.
signals.recommendation: Call the verified customer helpline on the back of your debit card or visit your branch.

signals.name: Contraband Courier & Customs Pretext
signals.reason: Fraudsters claim packages containing contraband were booked in your name to induce terror and extract extortion payments.
signals.recommendation: Verify consignments solely on the carrier's official website using your tracking number.

signals.name: Friend / Family Distress (Mom/Grandparent Scam)
signals.pattern: \b(hi mom|hi dad|hello mom|hello dad|lost my phone|new number|friend's phone|in hospital|met with an accident|emergency cash|send money urgently)\b
signals.reason: Exploits parental care by impersonating a child who lost their phone and desperately requires money.
signals.recommendation: Call the known existing phone number or confirm with mutual relatives before sending funds.

signals.name: Local In-App Blocklist Match
signals.reason: This domain was previously verified as hazardous and blacklisted by your security administrator.
signals.recommendation: Access to this website should remain blocked.

signals.name: Unencrypted HTTP Protocol
signals.reason: Traffic transmitted in plaintext without TLS/SSL encryption is subject to eavesdropping or tampering.
signals.recommendation: Never enter credentials or payment data on non-HTTPS portals.

signals.name: Raw IP Address Hostname
signals.reason: Direct numeric IP addresses are frequently utilized by botnets and disposable phishing servers.
signals.recommendation: Legitimate organizations utilize registered brand domain names.

signals.name: High-Risk Disposable TLD
signals.reason: Certain cheap or free top-level domains are statistically overrepresented in spam and phishing campaigns.
signals.recommendation: Exercise elevated caution when submitting data on uncommon TLDs.

signals.name: Targeted Brand Spoofing / Typosquatting
signals.reason: Contains known brand identifiers (SBI, HDFC, Google, PayPal) embedded within unauthorized domains.
signals.recommendation: Ensure the primary registered domain matches the official corporate identity.

signals.name: Nested Subdomain Masquerading
signals.reason: Attackers chain multiple subdomains (e.g. sbi.bank.login.portal...) to mimic authentic hostnames.
signals.recommendation: Inspect the root domain immediately preceding the TLD.

leak_detector.name: Leak Lock Secrets Scanner
leak_detector.privacy_policy: Zero-Knowledge Local Processing: Text is evaluated strictly in-memory. Secrets are masked deterministically. Raw keys are never stored in databases or exported.

signals.name: Cloud Provider Credentials (AWS/GCP)
signals.reason: Hardcoded cloud keys permit unauthorized infrastructure provisioning and sensitive data extraction.
signals.recommendation: Revoke key via cloud console, rotate credentials, and store in environment variables.

signals.name: AI Model & SaaS API Tokens (OpenAI/Anthropic)
signals.reason: Exposed LLM tokens lead to API quota exhaustion and unauthorized model access.
signals.recommendation: Revoke token on developer dashboard and monitor billing telemetry.

signals.name: Code Repository Tokens (GitHub PAT)
signals.reason: Personal access tokens allow direct read/write access to proprietary source repositories.
signals.recommendation: Revoke token from Developer Settings and regenerate with minimal scopes.

signals.name: Database Connection Strings with Credentials
signals.reason: Exposed URIs provide immediate remote database access bypassing network boundaries.
signals.recommendation: Rotate database user password and restrict connections to trusted VPC CIDRs.

signals.name: Cryptographic Private Keys (RSA/SSH)
signals.reason: Exposed private keys compromise server SSH authentication and TLS certificate integrity.
signals.recommendation: Remove public key from authorized_keys files immediately and generate a new keypair.

signals.name: Unjustified Camera or Microphone Access
signals.reason: Utility apps (e.g. flashlight, calculator) have no technical necessity for recording audio or capturing video.
signals.recommendation: Revoke permission in App Settings or switch to a reputable alternative.

signals.name: Unjustified Contacts or GPS Location Access
signals.reason: Contacts books and real-time physical locations are frequently harvested by predatory adware and loan apps.
signals.recommendation: Deny contacts and location permissions for non-navigation utility software.

signals.name: Excessive Background Execution Permissions
signals.reason: Permits silent execution when app is closed, leading to unmonitored data collection.
signals.recommendation: Restrict background execution to apps requiring active background sync.

signals.name: Urgent Money Request from Purportedly Known Voice
Refusal / Evasion of Secondary Visual Verification
Call from Unrecognized Number Claiming to be Known

session_detector.name: Account Hijacking & Session Anomaly Lab
session_detector.simulation_notice: Security Simulation: All events are synthetic demonstrations for defensive training and evaluation.

signals.name: Impossible Travel Velocity
signals.reason: Logins from physically distant regions within minutes indicate credential theft or proxy tunneling.
signals.recommendation: Invalidate active session and force password change with MFA.

signals.name: Automated Credential Stuffing Pattern
signals.reason: Rapid sequence of failed attempts followed by immediate privilege escalation.
signals.recommendation: Enforce IP rate-limiting and temporary account lockout.
